top_choice_rationale: Room-temperature tunnel magnetoresistance is a well-established physical effect with lasting use in storage and sensing. Its citation can be bounded to distinguish it from the giant magnetoresistance work recognized in 2007, though the chronology and relative contributions of the proposed laureates need historical review.
recusal_note: My research in theoretical magnetism and materials physics is close to the subject of P003. The supplied profile identifies no direct collaboration or institutional tie to its proposed laureates.
